description: postgresql.conf for PostgreSQL 16 — every parameter verified against the 16 docs.

fields.name: shared_buffers
fields.description: Shared memory buffers for page caching. Upstream default 128MB; the server usually overrides it from the role's memory at RunSpec compile.
fields.title: Shared buffers

fields.name: huge_pages
fields.description: Request huge pages for the shared memory region.
fields.title: Huge pages

fields.name: temp_buffers
fields.description: Per-session buffers for temporary tables.
fields.title: Temp buffers

fields.name: work_mem
fields.description: Memory per sort/hash operation before spilling to disk. Modeled in MB, so the sub-MB range of the upstream default is not reachable.
fields.title: Work mem

fields.name: hash_mem_multiplier
fields.description: work_mem multiplier for hash-based plan nodes.
fields.title: Hash mem multiplier

fields.name: maintenance_work_mem
fields.description: Memory for VACUUM, CREATE INDEX and ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY.
fields.title: Maintenance work mem

fields.name: effective_cache_size
fields.description: Planner-only estimate of the OS + PostgreSQL cache available to one query. Allocates nothing.
fields.title: Effective cache size

fields.name: wal_level
fields.description: How much information is written to the WAL. `replica` is the minimum for streaming replication.
fields.title: WAL level

fields.name: max_wal_size
fields.description: Soft limit on WAL growth between automatic checkpoints.
fields.title: Max WAL size

fields.name: min_wal_size
fields.description: WAL kept for recycling instead of being removed.
fields.title: Min WAL size

fields.name: checkpoint_timeout
fields.description: Maximum time between automatic WAL checkpoints.
fields.title: Checkpoint timeout

fields.name: checkpoint_completion_target
fields.description: Fraction of the checkpoint interval over which the checkpoint is spread.
fields.title: Checkpoint completion target

fields.name: wal_compression
fields.description: Compress full-page images written to the WAL. lz4 and zstd require a build with --with-lz4 / --with-zstd (both available since PostgreSQL 15).
fields.title: WAL compression

fields.name: synchronous_commit
fields.description: How much WAL durability a COMMIT waits for.
fields.title: Synchronous commit

fields.name: wal_buffers
fields.description: Shared memory for WAL not yet written to disk. `-1` derives it from shared_buffers; any other value must carry an explicit unit (a bare integer would mean 8kB blocks).
fields.title: WAL buffers

fields.name: fsync
fields.description: Force WAL and data file updates to physical storage. Turning it off makes crashes unrecoverable — benchmark use only.
fields.title: fsync

fields.name: full_page_writes
fields.description: Write the whole page to WAL on the first modification after a checkpoint; protects against torn pages.
fields.title: Full page writes

fields.name: wal_writer_delay
fields.description: How often the WAL writer flushes WAL.
fields.title: WAL writer delay

fields.name: max_wal_senders
fields.description: Maximum concurrent walsender processes; 0 disables replication.
fields.title: Max WAL senders

fields.name: max_replication_slots
fields.description: Maximum number of replication slots the server can define.
fields.title: Max replication slots

fields.name: hot_standby
fields.description: Allow read-only queries while the server is in recovery.
fields.title: Hot standby

fields.name: hot_standby_feedback
fields.description: Report the standby's oldest running xmin to the primary so vacuum does not remove rows it still needs.
fields.title: Hot standby feedback

fields.name: wal_keep_size
fields.description: Minimum size of past WAL segments kept in pg_wal for standbys.
fields.title: WAL keep size

fields.name: synchronous_standby_names
fields.description: Standby list that synchronous_commit waits for, e.g. "ANY 1 (pg1, pg2)". Filled by the server from topology; when a Patroni cluster owns the config, Patroni manages this key instead.
fields.title: Synchronous standby names

fields.name: seq_page_cost
fields.description: Planner cost of a sequentially fetched page.
fields.title: Sequential page cost

fields.name: random_page_cost
fields.description: Planner cost of a non-sequentially fetched page; lower it for SSD/NVMe storage.
fields.title: Random page cost

fields.name: effective_io_concurrency
fields.description: Number of concurrent I/O requests the planner expects the storage to sustain. Upstream default 1 up to PostgreSQL 17.
fields.title: Effective I/O concurrency

fields.name: jit
fields.description: Allow JIT compilation of expressions; usually off for OLTP benchmarks, where it only adds latency.
fields.title: JIT

fields.name: default_statistics_target
fields.description: Default number of ANALYZE histogram buckets / MCV entries per column.
fields.title: Default statistics target

fields.name: autovacuum
fields.description: Run the autovacuum launcher.
fields.title: Autovacuum

fields.name: autovacuum_max_workers
fields.description: Maximum concurrent autovacuum worker processes.
fields.title: Autovacuum max workers

fields.name: autovacuum_naptime
fields.description: Delay between autovacuum runs on any one database.
fields.title: Autovacuum naptime

fields.name: autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
fields.description: Minimum number of updated/deleted tuples before a table is vacuumed.
fields.title: Vacuum threshold

fields.name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold
fields.description: Minimum number of inserted tuples before a table is vacuumed; -1 disables insert-driven vacuums.
fields.title: Vacuum insert threshold

fields.name: autovacuum_analyze_threshold
fields.description: Minimum number of changed tuples before a table is analyzed.
fields.title: Analyze threshold

fields.name: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor
fields.description: Fraction of the table size added to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold.
fields.title: Vacuum scale factor

fields.name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor
fields.description: Fraction of the table size added to autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold.
fields.title: Vacuum insert scale factor

fields.name: autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor
fields.description: Fraction of the table size added to autovacuum_analyze_threshold.
fields.title: Analyze scale factor

fields.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay
fields.description: Cost delay used by autovacuum workers; -1 reuses vacuum_cost_delay.
fields.title: Autovacuum cost delay

fields.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit
fields.description: Cost limit shared by all autovacuum workers; -1 reuses vacuum_cost_limit.
fields.title: Autovacuum cost limit

fields.name: vacuum_cost_delay
fields.description: Sleep after the cost limit is exceeded during manual VACUUM; 0 disables cost-based delays.
fields.title: Vacuum cost delay

fields.name: vacuum_cost_limit
fields.description: Accumulated vacuum cost that triggers a sleep of vacuum_cost_delay.
fields.title: Vacuum cost limit

fields.name: vacuum_cost_page_hit
fields.description: Cost charged for a buffer found in shared_buffers.
fields.title: Vacuum cost: page hit

fields.name: vacuum_cost_page_miss
fields.description: Cost charged for a buffer that has to be read in.
fields.title: Vacuum cost: page miss

fields.name: vacuum_cost_page_dirty
fields.description: Cost charged when vacuum dirties a previously clean block.
fields.title: Vacuum cost: page dirty

fields.name: listen_addresses
fields.description: TCP addresses to listen on. Product default is '*' rather than upstream 'localhost': every stroppy node is reached over the network by the load generator and the exporters.
fields.title: Listen addresses

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port the server listens on.
fields.title: Port

fields.name: max_connections
fields.description: Maximum concurrent client connections.
fields.title: Max connections

fields.name: superuser_reserved_connections
fields.description: Connection slots out of max_connections reserved for superusers.
fields.title: Superuser reserved connections

fields.name: reserved_connections
fields.description: Connection slots reserved for roles with pg_use_reserved_connections. Added in PostgreSQL 16.
fields.title: Reserved connections

fields.name: ssl
fields.description: Enable SSL/TLS connections; requires ssl_cert_file and ssl_key_file.
fields.title: SSL

fields.name: tcp_keepalives_idle
fields.description: Idle time before the first TCP keepalive probe; 0 uses the OS default.
fields.title: TCP keepalives idle

fields.name: tcp_keepalives_interval
fields.description: Interval between TCP keepalive retransmits; 0 uses the OS default.
fields.title: TCP keepalives interval

fields.name: tcp_keepalives_count
fields.description: TCP keepalive probes lost before the connection is dropped; 0 uses the OS default.
fields.title: TCP keepalives count

fields.name: max_worker_processes
fields.description: Maximum background worker processes the cluster may start.
fields.title: Max worker processes

fields.name: max_parallel_workers
fields.description: Maximum workers usable for parallel operations; bounded by max_worker_processes.
fields.title: Max parallel workers

fields.name: max_parallel_workers_per_gather
fields.description: Workers a single Gather node may start; 0 disables parallel query.
fields.title: Max parallel workers per gather

fields.name: max_parallel_maintenance_workers
fields.description: Workers a single utility command (CREATE INDEX, VACUUM) may start.
fields.title: Max parallel maintenance workers

fields.name: max_locks_per_transaction
fields.description: Average number of object locks allocated per transaction slot.
fields.title: Max locks per transaction

fields.name: deadlock_timeout
fields.description: Time to wait on a lock before running deadlock detection.
fields.title: Deadlock timeout

fields.name: lock_timeout
fields.description: Abort a statement that waits longer than this for any lock; 0 disables.
fields.title: Lock timeout

fields.name: statement_timeout
fields.description: Abort any statement running longer than this; 0 disables.
fields.title: Statement timeout

fields.name: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout
fields.description: Terminate a session idle inside an open transaction for longer than this; 0 disables.
fields.title: Idle in transaction timeout

fields.name: logging_collector
fields.description: Capture stderr into rotated log files. Off in stroppy: journald/vector collect stderr.
fields.title: Logging collector

fields.name: log_destination
fields.description: Comma-separated log sinks: stderr, csvlog, jsonlog, syslog.
fields.title: Log destination

fields.name: log_min_duration_statement
fields.description: Log statements running at least this long; 0 logs all, -1 disables.
fields.title: Log min duration

fields.name: log_checkpoints
fields.description: Log each checkpoint and restartpoint.
fields.title: Log checkpoints

fields.name: log_connections
fields.description: Log every attempted connection. A boolean up to PostgreSQL 17; an aspect list from 18.
fields.title: Log connections

fields.name: log_disconnections
fields.description: Log session end and duration.
fields.title: Log disconnections

fields.name: log_lock_waits
fields.description: Log a session that waits longer than deadlock_timeout for a lock.
fields.title: Log lock waits

fields.name: log_temp_files
fields.description: Log temporary files at least this large; 0 logs all, -1 disables.
fields.title: Log temp files

fields.name: log_autovacuum_min_duration
fields.description: Log autovacuum actions taking at least this long; 0 logs all, -1 disables.
fields.title: Log autovacuum min duration

fields.name: log_line_prefix
fields.description: printf-style prefix on every stderr log line.
fields.title: Log line prefix

fields.name: log_statement
fields.description: Which statement kinds to log in full.
fields.title: Log statement

fields.name: extensions
fields.description: Shared libraries preloaded at server start; rendered into shared_preload_libraries. Filled by the server from the recipe (pg_stat_statements for the metrics dashboards, orioledb for the OrioleDB engine).
fields.title: Preloaded libraries

fields.name: shared_preload_libraries
fields.description: The `extensions` list joined with commas — the literal shared_preload_libraries value.
fields.title: shared_preload_libraries

fields.name: pg_stat_statements_max
fields.description: Number of statements tracked by pg_stat_statements. Rendered as `pg_stat_statements.max` (schemapb field names must be identifiers, so the dot cannot be in the field name).
fields.title: pg_stat_statements.max

fields.name: pg_stat_statements_track
fields.description: Which statements pg_stat_statements counts. Rendered as `pg_stat_statements.track`.
fields.title: pg_stat_statements.track

fields.name: pg_stat_statements_rendered
fields.description: The pg_stat_statements.* lines, emitted only when the extension is actually preloaded.

computed.expr: ("extensions" in root) && ("pg_stat_statements" in root.extensions) ? "pg_stat_statements.max = " + string(root.pg_stat_statements_max) + "\npg_stat_statements.track = " + string(root.pg_stat_statements_track) : ""

fields.title: Rendered pg_stat_statements settings

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Server time zone. Product default UTC so every run's timestamps line up with the metrics backend.
fields.title: Timezone

fields.name: lc_messages
fields.description: Locale for server log messages. Product default C so log parsers see English, untranslated messages.
fields.title: Message locale

fields.name: default_text_search_config
fields.description: Text search configuration used when none is given explicitly.
fields.title: Default text search config

fields.name: custom
fields.description: Raw `key = value` settings appended verbatim at the end of the file; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.title: Extra settings

fields.name: custom_rendered
fields.description: The `custom` map joined into config lines; the template prints it at the end of the file.
fields.title: Rendered extra settings
